utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll keep an eye out near the school pickup route and let you know as soon as I spot it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — I really appreciate you keeping watch near the school pickup route. Let me know right away if you spot anything, and I’ll keep the repair drive updates organized.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Of course — I’ll keep checking near the school pickup route and let you know as soon as I spot the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure — if you hear any updates, just pass them along and I’ll share them around the block. What do you need me to tell people about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Just tell folks it’s the repair drive soon, and I’ll get the invite list out—anyone who wants to help with supplies is welcome.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll tell people the repair drive is coming up and that anyone who can help with supplies is welcome. If I hear anything else, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey. We still need screws, duct tape, and a couple of small hand tools if you can find them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can keep an eye out for those and spread the word too. If I find anything, I’ll bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey—that’d be a big help. Let me know if you find anything, and I’ll keep a list going.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it—I’ll check my shed and see what I can find. I’ll bring anything useful by as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Oren—that would help a lot. I’ll double-check the flyer for the exact time and repair list, then we can compare notes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good—thanks, Hana. I’ll keep an eye out in my shed and bring over whatever I find.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — just let me know the time, and I’ll help fit it around school pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’ll take another look at the flyer and let you know if anything’s changed. Saturday should still be right, but I don’t want to steer you wrong.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Noah — Saturday sounds good for now. Just keep me posted if the flyer changes, and I’ll work around pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Uli — if you can bring the drill and help sort donations, that’d be a huge help. I’ll keep an eye out for clamps and anything else we’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can do that. I’ll bring the drill and help sort the donations.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, thanks, Uli — that’s a huge help. I’ll keep an eye out for the clamps and let you know if I spot anything else we need.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep an eye out for a cordless drill and some clamps while I’m out. If I spot anything, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. Could you also tell me if we still need help with the fence panels and that broken step?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll check on both while I’m out and let you know if they’re still needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds about right to me. I’ll plan to be there around 9 and bring anything specific I need fixed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll be there around 9 too and keep spreading the word to a few neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, that should help. I’ll see you around 9, and I’ll keep an eye out for anyone with a leaky faucet or a loose step.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can help sort the donated tools and label the boxes when they come in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be a huge help, Sam—thanks! I’m hearing there’s already a nice mix of donations, so I’ll let you know as soon as the boxes start coming in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good—just give me a heads-up when they start arriving, and I’ll get right on it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it’s still happening, but I’m still a bit worried about the timing and whether we have enough people lined up. If it’s after 3, I can do a pickup — I just need the route and how many stops there are first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, so it’s still on, but timing and headcount are both a bit iffy? If we can sort the route and number of stops, we can see if we need more people.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Exactly — if we can pin down the route and stop count, I can figure out whether my pickup fits and if we still need to recruit a couple more people.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what part of the repair drive needs the most help?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: The donated tools need sorting and the boxes need labels. If you can help with that, it’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can help sort the donated tools and label the boxes. If I can, I’ll also see if I can bring some paint and patch supplies.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Mostly just hands and a little time — if you can help sort donations or do a quick pickup, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure thing — I can help sort donations or do a quick pickup. I’ll spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be wonderful, Bo — thank you. I’ll let you know the time and spot as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds sensible. I’ll head over and see if they need anything else brought in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I’ll bring the paint and patch supplies and help sort things when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’ll be a big help, Dane. I’ll see you there and we can keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup and drop-off times for the repair drive—just let me know when you’re planning it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Faye — it’s at Maple Hall on 3rd Street this Saturday, 10 to 2. I’ll spread the word and bring any tools or spare parts I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — that time works for me, and I can help spread the word around school pickup and drop-off. Maple Hall on 3rd Street is easy enough to share.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just help spread the word and bring any tools or spare parts you’ve got. I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it — I’ll spread the word and bring what spare tools and parts I can. If you need anything specific, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus — if you come across a wrench set, a drill, or any extra screws, bring those along.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can do that. I’ll sort the donated tools and label the boxes when people arrive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be fantastic, Sam — thank you. I’ll keep the drop-off times organized and send you any updates on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Rosa — I appreciate it. I’ll be there to sort and label the tools when the donations come in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—I’ll double-check the flyer before I show up, just to make sure I’ve got the right time and list of repairs.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Hana — I appreciate that. Once Rosa sends the final details, I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sounds good—please send me the final time and repair list once you have them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Cleo—I’ve got you on the list, and helping track supplies sounds perfect. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything else about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn. Just keep me posted, and I’ll keep an eye out for those supplies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do—thanks, Cleo. I’ll keep you posted if anything new comes up about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — could you show me the other spots and tell me how many stops we’re talking about?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can show you the other spots, but I need the route first so I can judge the drive time. How many stops are we planning in total?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Let’s keep it to four stops total, and I’ll map the route before we go. I’ll show you the other spots after that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still keeping an eye out for that cordless drill and those clamps. If I spot anything useful while I’m out, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — just to confirm, the repair drive is still on, right? Do we mainly need to line up more people, or is timing the bigger issue?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, it’s still on — from what I’ve heard, we mainly need more folks lined up, and timing’s the part to keep an eye on.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still planning to swing by later and spread the word to a few more neighbors. Hopefully we can get a good turnout for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That would be great, Vik — spreading the word is exactly what we need. If you can also mention paint and patch supplies, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll mention the repair drive and the paint and patch supplies when I talk to folks later.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—Tess, we still need screws, duct tape, and a couple of small hand tools. I’m still nailing down the time, but I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve got it pinned down.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that sounds about right—there’s already a good mix of tools and spare parts coming in. Let me know when you’ve got the time pinned down, and I’ll keep an eye out for anything else useful.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Tess—that helps a lot. I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve got the time pinned down.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be a big help, Rey—if you can, I’d love for you to help sort donations or do a quick pickup. Just tell me what works best for you.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do a quick pickup, that works best for me. Just let me know what needs to be grabbed and when.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — thank you, Rey. I’ll send you the pickup details and a time that works.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s at Maple Hall on 3rd Street, Saturday from 10 to 2. I’ll send over the full list of needed items too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Opal — I’ll pass that along to a few neighbors around the block. Tools, lumber, and working lights, right?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’s right — tools, lumber, and working lights. I’ll send the full list too, just to make sure nothing gets missed.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
